profile:
COMPANY NAME: Insperity
INDUSTRY: Human Resources (HR) Services & Technology / Professional Employer Organization (PEO)
PRODUCT OR SERVICE: Insperity provides a combination of HR technology platforms and consultative or full-service PEO solutions, including payroll, benefits administration, compliance, and talent acquisition.
TARGET CUSTOMERS: Small, midsize, and large businesses (ranging from under 50 to 5,000 employees) across various industries such as manufacturing, IT/technology, professional services, and financial services.
PRICING MODEL: Enterprise / Subscription (Custom pricing based on company size and selected service tier)
KEY FEATURES:
- Tiered product offerings: Insperity HR Core (tech + service), Insperity HR 360 (full-service PEO), and Insperity HR Scale (Workday-based PEO for complex needs).
- Comprehensive HR administration including payroll, compliance, and benefits management.
- Talent acquisition and contractor management services.
- Integration with Workday technology for larger enterprises.
- Retirement and insurance services.
UNIQUE SELLING POINTS:
- "Award-winning" HR service and technology with 40 years of innovation.
- Flexible tiers allowing businesses to choose between technology-only support or full-service PEO co-employment.
- Specific solution (HR Scale) leveraging Workday for businesses with complex HR technology requirements.
- Focus on "HR Cost Clarity" and competitive employee benefits.
TONE & POSITIONING: Enterprise / Professional / Trustworthy
